purpose: Finite-resource longitudinal observations and separate short scaling probes; no biological rule changes
anatomy: showcase(seed), FoodPouch added by canonical habitat startup
limits: Wall budgets are checked between complete atomic ticks; a tick may exceed the budget
Replay runs after measurement and outside the wall budget
1200 ticks are 20 simulated seconds and cannot establish ecological stability
Short scaling runs end before the default birth interval and are not growth evidence
Mortality and metabolic consumption are unimplemented; no extinction or survival claim
Founders above 16 are refused by current rules, not measured engine capacity
